views.label: the meridian half plane
caption: The Kretschmann scalar $K$ of the magnetic dipole over the meridian half plane ($b = 2\sqrt{2}\,m$), the same at every $t$ and $\phi$. We draw Bonnor's $r$ and $\theta$ as polar coordinates, with the strut on the inner semicircle. The Ricci scalar vanishes.
views.settings: $m = 1$, the unit of every length, and $b = 2\sqrt{2}\,m$.
views.clip: We colour $K\,m^4$ logarithmically from $10^{-4}$ to $10$, over $4 < r/m \le 8$. Every coloured cell lies within the scale; cells outside this radial interval stay clear.
